title: Cottage Cheese Waffles
summary: These cottage cheese waffles are crispy, protein-packed, and blend together in minutes. No flour, no fuss, just a family breakfast on repeat.
steps: Add all the ingredients to a blender in the order listed. Blend until smooth and well combined, scraping down the sides if needed.

Lightly grease the waffle maker if needed, then pour in the batter (I like to use a 1/2 measuring cup) and cook according to your machine’s instructions—usually about 3–5 minutes until golden and crisp.
Serve warm with your favorite toppings!
